summary: Saskatchewan fire tower known only from a website listing of its coordinates; sources found give no build date, height or present state.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Firetowers of Saskatchewan listing gives only coordinates for Greenwater; its height, year and towermen fields are blank, so the story states no build date, height, staffing or fate. The record's agency (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency) and staffing note (no observer, cameras from 2013-14) do not appear in any page read, so neither is in facts; both need a source before use. The Big River history (cite 2) covers the province's tower network and that district, not this site. No register, agency or news source for Greenwater was found in two searches. Status and access left unknown.
